castor is a really good support: he generates a lot of shield, corrosion, and does some draw. He's generally really good and some teams love him for stalling etc. His wheel is also notably reallyy good.

Xu singlehandedly makes poison teams work. She triggers poison, makes enemies take more poison damage, applies poison etc. Outside that, she also reduces the damage enemies deal, generates arithmetica and embryos for caro, and does str down, so she has use outside that too. Her exalt also does HP% damage which is always handy to have.

Miryam is not as great as the other two imo, but still really good. She functions as a battery that generates a lot of aliemus for her teammates, and she has some healing, tentacle gen, and other uses. She also provides a slight realm mastery buff and has a really good rouse, and she's more or less mandatory on the "lemurians" team (it's a tentacle team featuring Gmurphy/tulu/miryam)
